children: Ares Real Estate Income Trust reported an August 31, 2026 NAV per Fund Interest of $8.2769 and aggregate Fund NAV of $3.9379 billion.
Aggregate Fund NAV rose to $3,937,946k as of Aug 31, 2026, up from $3,909,724k on Jul 31, 2026.
NAV per Fund Interest increased to $8.2769 for all share classes (monthly NAV basis).
Total investments were $10,205,921k, including $9,028,100k in real estate properties across 168 properties (~35M sq ft, 35 markets, 95% leased).
Leverage ratio was 34% as of Aug 31, 2026 (borrowings less cash divided by selected asset fair value).
Authorized monthly gross distribution of $0.03583 per share for August 2026, up from $0.03450 previously.
